deadline.value: The EE PhD pages send applicants to the graduate school website for deadlines; no date is given.
deadline.quote: See the graduate school website for application deadlines and required forms

gre_general.value: The General GRE (Verbal and Quantitative) is required for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: For PhD applicants only: | the General GRE test (Verbal and Quantitative) is required

also.quote: Passing scores in the EE Department for the General GRE Verbal portion is 146 and for the General GRE Quantitative

toefl_min.value: The EE admission page lists TOEFL iBT 79, the old-scale figure, so check with the department.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test applies to electrical engineering.

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether an advisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The EE pages do not state a funding rule.

entry_route.value: The PhD counts 72 graduate hours after a bachelor's; up to 30 hours can be credited for a prior master's.
entry_route.quote: Total Required: A minimum of 72 graduate hours beyond bachelor's degree | Up to 30 credit hours may be awarded for previous master's degree
